content:
The analysis failed due to incorrect assumption values and significant calculation discrepancies in annual margin totals.
AssertionError in test_metadata_and_schema showed 'runs_per_year_small_kit' was 12 instead of the expected 24. In test_rows_and_order, a value mismatch occurred where close(441.6, 5740.8) returned False. The total annual margin for small kits was calculated as 21496.81 but expected -7106.39. Finally, test_summary_requirements failed because the formatted string '21,496.81' (with comma) was missing from the summary text.
